text.p: BLANTYRE - Feb 24 (Reuter) These are the leading stories in the Malawi Press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A tripartite round-table talk between the ruling United Democratic Front (UDF) and opposition Alliance For Democracy (AFORD) and Malawi Congress Party (MCP) to end a feud involving AFORD MPs serving in cabinet will take place this Thursday in Lilongwe, the Malawi capital.
- Police in Blantyre on Saturday arrested a white American missionary, Peter Halliman of Landmark Baptist Church, for allegedly shooting dead a man who was felling down trees near his house.
- The Electoral Commission is expected to appear before the High Court in a law suit in which the ruling United Democractic Front (UDF) is challenging the commission's independence.
- A back-packer Canadian tourist, Megan Watson, is hospitalised with severe head injuries after an attack by a gang of armed thugs on Wednesday soon after she arrived in Blantyre from Harare.
- Staff members at Lilongwe Central Hospital have petitioned government requesting that it immediately relieve the only surgeon presently working at the hospital who is overloaded with work.

- Eight people are alleged to have dug up and unearthed a coffin of a dead woman, two days after burial and removed her eyes, teeth, breasts and external sex organs in Mzimba district of Northern Malawi.
